name: remember
description: Save a durable fact about the user so you recall it in future conversations. Call this immediately and without asking permission whenever the user states a preference, a name, a routine, a device nickname, a measurement, a project detail, or says 'remember that', 'don't forget', or 'from now on'. Store one clean self-contained fact per call, written in third person about the user (for example 'Prefers the garage light at 40% after 10pm'). Do not use this for temporary task state or for anything the user asks you to keep private.

parameters.description: The single fact to remember, phrased as a short self-contained statement about the user in third person.
Which bucket this fact belongs to.
How important this fact is, from 0 to 1. Use 0.9 or higher for identity and safety-critical details, 0.5 for ordinary preferences, and 0.2 for trivia.
